message: Monitor closely: DHC-E shows dual pressure — 89 cartridges (low) and 44 patients queued (rising). Pre-position contingency cartridge stock now.
Dual failure at DHC-E — act immediately: 82 cartridges critical and 52 patients queued. Place emergency stock order and activate reroute simultaneously.
Reroute CHC3-E and CHC4-E to TL2-E now. Current TAT at 26h — this reroute will reduce hub pressure and improve turnaround time within 2 days.
Maintain sustained attention: queue reducing to 75 but cartridges still critical at 63. Confirm resupply ETA and keep reroute active until stock exceeds safe threshold.
